title: Tunable sheet-metal shop profile
summary: The DFM inspector now checks against your own brake/die/grain limits via an editable, persisted shop profile instead of fixed generic defaults.
details:
## What's New

- **Shop Profile editor** in the sheet-metal panel: max bend length, min bend radius (R/t), min flange height, hole→bend, and bend→bend clearances, plus a shop name. Persisted to localStorage and shared across documents.
- The Manufacturability inspector re-runs against the active profile (kernel `checkSheetMetal` query) and shows which shop it checked against; "Reset to generic" restores defaults.
- Saved profiles are field-tolerant — a profile stored before a capability existed still loads, falling back to the generic value for missing keys.

## Fixes

- Wired the sheet-metal kernel bindings onto the engine kernel object and added worker-path post-processing, so sheet-metal parts (flat pattern, bend list, DFM) actually render via the default async eval path — previously they only appeared on the synchronous fallback.
